name: Lily Williams

positions.question: Do you generally support pro-choice or pro-life legislation?

evidence.text: "The Supreme Court has ruled this is a states’ right issue. If elected to the U.S. House, I will not vote in favor of any federal law concerning any aspect of abortion (pro, anti, or anywhere in between). It is the right of New Hampshire citizens to decide this issue for them. I will respect the right of the people of New Hampshire to vote on it through their representative government."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Social Security and Medicare are programs our seniors have paid into their whole working lives. Seniors can count on me to fight for them and protect those earned benefits. We must strengthen the protections of these benefits by severely limiting Federal Government borrowing from the Social Security Trust Fund. Social Security is not a political slush fund; this is money the Federal Government should not play with."

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: "Great questions. I have been warning about all of the above as someone born & raised in China, but why now just go after TikTok? Why does the House bill give lots of power to the President & AG? Why not just have a simple & clean bill on TikTok? We need to be more cautious."

"I know personally how bad CCP is, I have been warning the public about #TikTok and other Chinese apps, but this is not a clean bill about TikTok. I have read the entire H.R.7521 passed by the US House. Remember the devils are in the details, we can't simply trust the "sounds good" intensions. This is a bad bill giving too much power to the US President and Attorney General. I wonder who drafted this bill. US Senate should not pass it. In the name of national security, our own government could use and abuse this new power to ban other apps, threatens our free speech. There are better ways to protect users and protect minors. We should continue to have national conversations about TikTok and other apps, companies that infringe our free speech and data privacy."

"People have to speak freely to think freely. We must exchange ideas and communicate with each other to get to the truth and arrive at mutually agreeable solutions to problems we face as a country. When others wish to control speech, they want to control thoughts, and keep those they wish to control from knowing the truth. Freedom of speech is meant to protect the listener first! Censorship exercised by collusion between government and big tech or the media is immoral and dangerous."

"This is a bad bill giving too much power to the US President and AG. US Senate should not pass it. I know personally how bad CCP is, but this is not a clean bill about just TikTok. In the name of national security, our own government could use this law to ban other apps."
